questions.prompt: A bike-share program charges $4 to unlock a bike, plus $2 for each started 15-minute block of riding. Answer each part.
questions.answer: (a) $6; (b) $8; (c) $12; (d) It is a step function: the cost stays constant within each 15-minute block and jumps by $2 at 15, 30, 45, … minutes.
solutionSteps: A ride of t minutes (t > 0) costs 4 + 2·⌈t/15⌉ dollars.
(a) 10 min → 1 block. (b) 15.5 min → 2 blocks. (c) 60 min → 4 blocks.
(d) The graph is flat on each block and jumps at multiples of 15.
